outcome: Length of second stage of labor
cohort: 231 nulliparous women at 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Larger levator hiatus dimensions in late pregnancy were significantly associated with a shorter active second stage of labor and normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women with larger levator hiatus dimensions at rest, during contraction, and during Valsalva maneuver were more likely to have a normal vaginal delivery compared to instrumental delivery.
